summary.ko: 확인된 문제·접근·결과를 과장 없이 설득력 있는 고객 사례로 구성합니다.
summary.en: Turn documented client work into a credible problem, approach, and outcome narrative.

required_inputs.description: Verified project context, scope, actions, and outcomes
What client identity, quotes, screenshots, and metrics may be used

workflow.instruction: Separate project facts, evidence, attribution rights, and confidentiality restrictions.
Build a problem, constraints, approach, deliverables, and outcome narrative that reflects the actual contribution.
Use supported metrics with baselines and time windows; use qualitative outcomes when numeric evidence is unavailable.
Prepare the draft and a publication-clearance checklist for any client names, logos, quotes, or sensitive details.

deliverables.name: Case-study draft
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Accurately attributes work and includes evidence-linked outcomes

deliverables.name: Clearance checklist
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Tracks permission status for identities, quotes, visuals, and metrics

limitations: Do not invent client praise, revenue impact, or causation.
Anonymization may still leave a client identifiable; disclose that risk.
permission_boundaries: Do not publish confidential work or seek client approval by sending messages without authorization.
Uncleared names, logos, and quotes remain excluded or marked for approval.
